scope: Technical root-cause analysis only; no rescue, retuning, threshold change, classifier change, endpoint change, population change, or consumed-seed rerun.

rootCause.productionImplementation: tools/experiments/lib/rcpr-production.js::entropy(values) uses Map and accumulates probability terms in insertion order.
rootCause.independentImplementation: tools/experiments/lib/rcpr-independent.js::shannon(values) uses a plain object and accumulates Object.values(counts). Integer-like object keys enumerate in numeric order rather than insertion order.
rootCause.mechanism: The two implementations sum the same entropy terms in a different order. IEEE-754 addition is not associative, creating exact-value differences at approximately 2.22e-16 to 4.44e-16. Exact feature-vector hashing therefore fails even though the substantive quantities are numerically equivalent at ordinary analytical precision.
